subject.title: Feishu Bitable write operations return 400 after bot/app replacement

question: Should Feishu Bitable table tools remain app/tenant-token-only with better bot-replacement diagnostics, or should OpenClaw add a user-auth path for table-level Bitable operations?
rationale: Current source and the packaged SDK show the tools use appId/appSecret tenant-token calls; switching to user auth affects token handling, config, and security posture, and the live Feishu error is not yet available.

options.title: Collect live error first
options.body: Ask for or run a redacted Feishu bot-replacement repro that captures code/msg/log_id before choosing diagnostics or auth changes.

options.title: Keep tenant-token behavior
options.body: Treat the failure as setup/permission drift and improve diagnostics plus docs without adding user-token state.

options.title: Design user auth
options.body: Sponsor a Feishu user-token design for table tools, including storage, refresh, setup, and security review.

recommendation.title: Collect live error first
recommendation.body: Ask for or run a redacted Feishu bot-replacement repro that captures code/msg/log_id before choosing diagnostics or auth changes.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu plugin is marked as community maintained by this handle and they were already pulled into this issue's timeline.
